about: Wayback captures wanted for the gap-state sources of piece s4d: round 1's Cowles Montana ticker and pages, Flathead County and the Shasta and Trinity county offices' sheets; round 2's district-level sources (Apptegy homepages, Finalsite page-pops and Smart Sites pop-up alert files of the Florida, Montana, Idaho and Wyoming districts) and GOHSEP's parish layer. Each request below was sent through archive-requests.json (the archive-captures workflow reads its 'cdx' and 'snapshots' keys) and its result is noted. 'still_wanted' lists what no run has answered yet: merge it into archive-requests.json to ask again. Round 2's second pass adds the 82 district sites it built (Montana, Wyoming, Florida and Idaho): their homepages near their counties' strongest winter-warning school days and listings of their pages and alert files. Proof rule (round 2, 2026-09-28): a capture of a district's alert channel proves that source only when a row of it announces a closing, a delay, an early dismissal, a remote day, cancelled classes, or weather or an emergency; a capture of a status board (Flathead, the Shasta and Trinity sheets, GOHSEP) only when a row's status is other than open (notices.gate_proofs). Hiring, board, election and calendar banners are read but prove nothing. Round 3 (2026-09-28) adds the 79 South Texas district sites it built (Apptegy, Finalsite and Smart Sites sites of the districts of Hidalgo, Nueces, Cameron, Victoria, Webb, El Paso, San Patricio and the smaller uncovered counties) and three Edlio homepages (Edinburg, Mission, Los Fresnos; no adapter yet): their pages on the area's storm days (the January 2025 snow, the February 2021 and January 2024 freezes, the January 2026 cold, Tropical Storm Harold, Hurricanes Hanna and Beryl, the February 2022 cold and El Paso snow), and listings of the smaller sites' homepages and alert files since mid-2020. Round 4 (2026-09-28) adds the Mobile - Pensacola market's district sites (Mobile County, Baldwin County, Santa Rosa, Escambia, Washington, Chickasaw, Monroe, Clarke, Saraland, Gulf Shores, Orange Beach, Satsuma, Thomasville, Brewton, Floretta P. Carson), the Alabama State Department of Education's statewide School Closures/Delays list, KQ2's closings file (St. Joseph, MO) and WHIZ's closings block (Zanesville, OH; not built): listings of their pages since 2017 and captures on the market's storm days (the January 2025 Gulf Coast snow, Hurricanes Sally, Zeta, Ida, Francine, Michael and Gordon, the January 2024 and January 2026 cold) and on the St. Joseph and Zanesville winter-warning days. Round 5 (2026-09-28): the Finalsite sources are now read through their homepages, and an archived homepage is read too (an older template holding its page pops in the page, a Web Community Manager homepage's important announcements), so storm-day captures of the Montana Finalsite districts' homepages can prove them: the planner's picks from the listings already downloaded (Great Falls, Havre, Hellgate, Hobson homepages; Billings, Bozeman, Kalispell and East Helena page pops), and listings of the other Montana Finalsite homepages since November 2018.
